title: Dare To Doku
description: This game was made for the GBA Jam 2026 (https://itch.io/jam/gbajam26). A star-battle puzzle game (also known as queens) for the Game Boy Advance, set in the universe of our main game Dare To Square (https://hh.gbdev.io/game/dare-to-square-demo). The goal of the game is to find all players hidden in the grid. You will need to apply a basic set of rules to deduct the locations, similar to minesweeper.The game features 10.000 unique levels (with a grid size of 4 through 10), a challenge mode with leaderboard and a small tutorial to explain the rules of the game.
